host.lane: CPU (LAIR q4/q4 mirror vs pinned llama.cpp reference, sequenced to avoid core contention)
notes: Host core counts were not recorded in this narrative; recorded as null rather than inferred.
Reference engine: pinned llama.cpp b12032 server mode, -ctk q4_0 -ctv q4_0.
Runtime shape: context 1024, threads 8, greedy sampling with seed 0 and top-5 logprobs captured from llama.cpp server mode.
Sequencing rule: for each fixture, llama-server is stopped before LAIR starts so the two engines do not contend for CPU cores during measurement.

gatePosture: Candidates within 6 nats of the reference top-1 must stay inside the quantized-file band (1 nat) and LAIR's argmax must remain among the reference top-5. No dense-family band is widened, and no q4-specific tolerance is adopted unless it clears measurement first.
